issues.description: Invalid use of **sh:property** inside a property shape for the unit constraint of **vocab:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement**. SHACL does not allow nested sh:property constraints; they must be placed inside a **sh:node** shape.
issues.suggestion: Wrap the unit constraint in a node shape, e.g.: `sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:path qudt:unit ; sh:hasValue unit:KiloTON_Metric ] ]`.

issues.description: Invalid use of **sh:property** inside a property shape for the numeric value constraint of **vocab:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement**.
issues.suggestion: Wrap the numeric value constraint in a node shape, e.g.: `sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:path qudt:numericValue ; sh:datatype xsd:decimal ] ]`.

issues.description: Invalid use of **sh:property** inside a property shape for the unit constraint of **vocab:waterlineCaseDisplacement** (nested case shape).
issues.suggestion: Replace the nested sh:property with a sh:node containing the unit constraint, similar to the fix for the ship displacement property.

issues.description: Invalid use of **sh:property** inside a property shape for the numeric value constraint of **vocab:waterlineCaseDisplacement**.
issues.suggestion: Wrap the numeric value constraint in a sh:node as described above.

issues.description: Missing minimum displacement requirement: the regulation states that the ship displacement (DUI) shall be **at least 10 kt**. The SHACL shape does not enforce this lower bound.
issues.suggestion: Add a constraint on the numeric value, e.g.: `sh:node [ sh:property [ sh:path qudt:numericValue ; sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:minInclusive "10"^^xsd:decimal ] ]` to ensure the displacement is ≥ 10 kt.

change_review.reason: Restructuring of path logic (integrating the UpperIceWaterlineCase shape into ShipShape) preserves the intended semantics and does not introduce regressions.
The SPARQL constraint was retained; its logic matches the requirement that ship displacement equals the maximum case displacement.
Removal of the separate target class for UpperIceWaterlineCase is appropriate because the case is now validated as a nested node of ShipShape.
Type changes (e.g., adding `sh:class qudt:QuantityValue`) correctly reflect the quantity nature of the operands.
Cardinality adjustments were applied without affecting required validation.
